no-reader:orders.title: Nobody reads Orders
no-reader:orders.message: Checkout publishes to Orders, but nothing consumes it: it keeps every message, unread.

fix.label: Add a consumer…
fix.choice: Pick what reads Orders, then add it and connect orders to it.

retry-backoff:pay.title: Retries to Payments need jittered backoff.
retry-backoff:pay.message: Checkout retries in step with every other caller: waves of retries reach Payments together.
retry-backoff:pay.rationale: Retries add load when a dependency is struggling. Bound repeated work and keep it safe to repeat.

fix.label: Use jittered backoff (100 ms ×2, up to 2 s, full jitter)

retry-idempotency:pay.title: Retries to Payments may repeat a POST.
retry-idempotency:pay.message: A timed-out request may have succeeded; repeating it can charge twice.
retry-idempotency:pay.rationale: Retries add load when a dependency is struggling. Bound repeated work and keep it safe to repeat.

options.label: It's idempotent (it has an idempotency key)

retry-storm:pay.title: A slowdown at Payments would become a retry storm.
retry-storm:pay.message: In a 5 s slowdown (×5), retries keep Payments overloaded at least 20 s after it recovers. Uses jittered backoff, a 20% retry budget, a circuit breaker and a deadline-based queue limit. The replayed change recovers in 6 s; successful work after clearing rises from 0 to 4905.
retry-storm:pay.rationale: Retries add load when a dependency is struggling. Bound repeated work and keep it safe to repeat.
retry-storm:pay.shownMessage: In a 5 s slowdown (×5), retries keep Payments overloaded at least 20 s after it recovers.
